snippet.title: Machinarium 2 - World Premiere Trailer | The Triple-i Initiative
snippet.description:
Learn more about Machinarium 2: https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619280/Machinarium_2/

Machinarium 2 is the sequel to Amanita Design's 2009 adventure classic. Finally reunited and searching for a new home, Josef and Berta discover a hidden valley settled by two peculiar robot tribes slowly running short of power. This time you guide both heroes, switching between them freely to crack puzzles neither could solve alone. The whole game is hand-drawn and expressively animated, giving a world of rusted machines something unexpectedly human. Tomáš Dvořák, aka Floex returns to compose the score.

Machinarium 2 Store Page:
https://store.steampowered.com/app/1619280/Machinarium_2/
